status: release_gate_passed; implementation round 3 closed by integration review
environment: macOS x86_64, Python 3.13; two independent venvs, no editable, no system site packages, PYTHONPATH unset, scripts use python -I

commands.stdout:
usage: terra [-h] [--version]
             {model,solve,inspect,scene,export,probe,compare} ...

Earth normal modes: SI physics, explicit display scaling, reproducible
exports.

positional arguments:
  {model,solve,inspect,scene,export,probe,compare}
    model               Write a validated SI material Model JSON.
    solve               Solve a Model JSON; config keys use the Python SI API.
    inspect             Inspect frequencies and separate numerical quality
                        evidence.
    scene               Create a recommended scene bound to a bundle hash.
    export              Render a bundle + scene, or a saved self-contained
                        project.
    probe               Sample a fixed material point; raw units are
                        canonical, not earthquake metres.
    compare             Compare explicit identities in separate models; no
                        automatic mode tracking.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit
